# pai launch

Start Claude Code on a chosen provider (for scripts)

```
pai launch [options]
```

Starts a fresh Claude Code process in the current terminal on the provider and model you name. A running session cannot change provider, so this always starts a new one.
Without --provider in a terminal it shows a numbered table to pick from; --list prints the table and stops. Arguments after `--` go to claude unchanged.
For everyday use prefer `pai new` and `pai open`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider NAME` | string | — | Provider to start on (default: pick from the table) |
| `--model ID` | string | — | Model id on that provider (default: its default model) |
| `--list` | flag | — | Print the provider and model table and stop |
| `--current` | flag | — | With --list: mark this session's own provider and model |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the exec line instead of executing |

```sh
pai launch --list
pai launch --provider glm --dry-run
pai launch --provider glm -- --resume 3a9f1c2e
```

See also: `pai new`, `pai open`, `pai providers`
